title: Dus Feesad Aur! | Wheat Crop | Sarsabz Fertilizers
description: We conducted in-depth research and analysis on 500+ demo plots across Pakistan to prove that NP and CAN when compared to conventional fertilizers Urea and DAP, gives on average 10% more yield on Wheat (...and other crops such as Rice, Potato, Maize and Sugarcane!). title: Sarsabz Dhaan Seminar, Gujranwala 2017
description: Sarsabz Fertilizer (Fatima Fertilizer) in association with Government of Punjab & Rice Research Institute organized Dhaan (Rice) Seminar at Marrion Hotel, Gujranwala on 7th September 2017.  The event hosted 3000+ farmers, Secretary Agriculture Punjab Government, DG Agriculture Research, DG Pest Warning, Director Wheat Research, Rice Exporters, President Kissan Ittehad and other stakeholders from Agriculture industry.  Topics discussed ranged from Rice Agronomy & Production Techniques, Balanced use of Sarsabz Fertilizer NP and CAN, Export Market Analysis and other latest research on rice.
